text.title: Context Budget Record — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: a Context Budget Record as YAML or JSON, machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: Path to the context file under audit, relative to the repository root.
Who wrote it. `llm` is the variant the evidence says is negative (r1).
Why this file may exceed the default.

Classification of the whole file. Each item: `lines` ("12-30"), `kind` (instruction|overview|preference), `decision` (keep|cut|relocate), `relocate_to` (required when decision is relocate), `confirmed_by_human` (bool, required true for keep), `marked_as_preference` (bool, required true for a kept preference).
Sum of the line counts of every block with `decision: keep`. Must be arithmetically consistent with `blocks` and must not exceed `ceiling`.
Runs per arm on the same task set (r7).
Median currency cost per run with no context file.
Median currency cost per run with the cut file.
What the extra spend buys. Absent, a cost increase is not accepted.
Median task success rate with no context file, 0..1.
Median task success rate with the cut file, 0..1.
Diagnostic only. Never the headline cost figure (r7).

section.title: Stop condition
section.statement: When `authored_by: llm` and no block carries `confirmed_by_human: true`, the record is COMPLETE at `verdict: delete` — the measurement is not required, because the evidence already covers this cell and the cheapest correct action is removal. Measuring an unconfirmed machine-written file before deleting it spends money to re-derive a published result.

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: `kept_lines` must equal the summed span of every `keep` block and must not exceed `ceiling`. A `ceiling` above 200 requires `ceiling_justification`. No block may be `kind: overview` with `decision: keep`. Every `keep` block requires `confirmed_by_human: true`; every kept `preference` block also requires `marked_as_preference: true`; every `relocate` block requires a non-empty `relocate_to`. `runs` must be at least 5. If `cost_usd_after` exceeds `cost_usd_baseline`, `cost_accepted_because` is required. If `success_after` is not greater than `success_baseline` while cost rose, the verdict must be `cut` or `delete` — never `keep`.
